title: Hydra-Gen Engine
description: At work I led a team on an ambitious SR&ED project to construct an engine capable of producing all future applications for both web and desktop. Hydra-Gen stands for one engine that can generate many application types. The principal concept was to give content creators the means to build their own software. This was accomplished by creating scriptable pages, panels, and widgets coupled with custom XML BNF syntax. Pages are usually populated from a massive database store, MassCon, where user input is saved through the Rosetta Database, SmartDB. SmartDB is compatible with SimpleDB, SQL Server, MySQL, and other flat-file formats such as Access, Berkeley DB, and our custom ISAM BTree.
